jobs.occupation: Advances in NMR techniques for next generation Foodomics
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Food Science programme. The position is available from 01 February 2026 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Advances in NMR techniques for next generation Foodomics

Research area and project description
The Department of Food Science at Aarhus University is inviting applications for a Ph.D. student position focused on the development and applications of NMR spectroscopy in the characterization of foods - Foodomics.

Foodomics is a scientific approach that studies food, nutrition and their effects on health using omics technologies. NMR spectroscopy has played a key role in establishing Foodomics and has offered distinctive insights into foods’ health-promoting potential as well as their functional characteristics. However, ¹H NMR spectroscopy, which is the current workhorse of NMR-based Foodomics, has some analytical limitations. Thus, spectral overlap renders substantial parts of the food metabolome unidentified.

This PhD project aims at developing and examining new and alternative NMR-based approaches within Foodomics. This includes elucidating the potential of ¹³C NMR spectroscopy, which so far has been limited applied in Foodomics. For this purpose, sensitivity-enhancement strategies will be explored, including a dissolution dynamic nuclear polarization technique (d-DNP). This will be done in collaboration with a prominent European d-DNP group.

The PhD project will entail studies on new foods of alternative sources and/or derived from innovative biotechnological processing techniques and solutions.

Tasks and responsibilities include:

• 
Conduct research on development and applications of NMR spectroscopy in food science.

• 
Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team including a 4-6-months stay in an international research environment abroad.

• 
Design and implement experiments, collect and analyse data, and interpret results.

• 
Present findings at conferences and publish research in reputable peer-reviewed journals.

• 
Participate in outreach activities to disseminate research outcomes to stakeholders and contribute to teaching in the department

Qualifications and specific competences
Applicants must have a relevant master’s degree (120 ECTS) in chemistry, biotechnology, food technology, or in a related field.

The preferred candidate has substantial hands-on experience in NMR spectroscopy. Relevant expertise in food science, foodomics, multivariate data analysis and good analytical skills is an advantage.

The successful candidate should be motivated to combine laboratory work and experiments, data processing and analysis and ability to work independently and as part of a team in an international research environment.

Place of employment and place of work
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Department of Food Science, Agro Food Park 48, Dk-8200 Aarhus N., Denmark.

Contacts
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:

• 
Hanne Christine Bertram, e-mail: Hannec.bertram@food.au.dk (main supervisor)

For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:

• 
admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk

How to apply
Please follow this link to submit your application.

Application deadline is 26 November 2026 at 23:59 CET.

Preferred starting date is 01 February 2027.

For technical reasons, you must upload a project description. Please copy the project description above and upload it as a PDF in the application.

Please make a project description (½-4 pages). The project description should describe your ideas and research plans for this specific project. If you wish to, you can indicate an URL where further information can be found.

Please note:

• 
Only documents received prior to the application deadline will be evaluated. Thus, documents sent after deadline will not be considered.

• 
The programme committee may request further information or invite the applicant to attend an interview.

• 
Shortlisting will be used, which means that the evaluation committee only will evaluate the most relevant applications.

Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which everyone has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via the online recruitment system, which can be accessed under ‘How to apply’.

drafting complex IP agreements

jobs.occupation: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) wanted for strong, supportive team
jobs.description:
Design solutions that solve whole classes of problems rather than individual tasks. As a Senior SRE at Systematic, you keep the systems running that healthcare staff and patients depend on.

Would you like to shape the future of our infrastructure by designing scalable, elegant solutions that solve classes of problems rather than individual tasks? Join our skilled Site Reliability Engineering team where you’ll have the opportunity to think beyond the immediate fix and architect systems that transform how we operate at scale. Your work will keep healthcare solutions running for the clinicians and care staff who depend on them.

The job

As a Senior SRE with a systems engineering mindset, you’ll work at the intersection of deep technical expertise and strategic thinking. You’ll identify patterns across our diverse infrastructure, from Kubernetes clusters to Azure VMs, and create unified solutions that eliminate entire categories of operational toil. This isn’t about fixing one deployment pipeline; it’s about building a framework that makes all deployments reliable. This isn’t about patching one vulnerability; it’s about architecting a security posture that scales across our organization.

You’ll have access to cutting-edge technologies and the autonomy to innovate, with opportunities to work across multiple environments including our ao-admin Kubernetes cluster, Docker-based deployments, Azure-hosted infrastructure, and healthcare-focused systems. When you are ready, you will join the SRE team’s on-call rotation.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Architect automation systems that eliminate classes of manual work, thinking in terms of platforms and capabilities rather than individual scripts

• Develop infrastructure tooling that empowers development teams to self-service their operational needs while maintaining reliability standards

• Build observability frameworks that provide unified insights across diverse environments, making patterns visible and actionable

• Create abstraction layers that hide complexity while providing powerful capabilities, whether through Terraform modules, Helm charts, or custom operators

• Drive infrastructure evolution by identifying systemic improvements and leading their implementation from concept to production

• Collaborate with development teams to understand their patterns of needs and design operations-ready solutions that scale

• Mentor team members in systems thinking and architectural approaches, sharing your problem-solving methodology

• Apply best practices in site reliability engineering, advocating for solutions that improve reliability, security, and maintainability at scale

• Research and prototype emerging technologies and approaches, evaluating their fit for solving our systemic challenges

Joining the team

You’ll join one of our two skilled SRE teams, each consisting of approximately 10 professionals working from our offices in Aarhus and Bucharest. Our teams operate with a DevOps philosophy and use a mix of Scrum and Kanban methodologies depending on the project needs.

We value engineers who can see the forest and the trees, who understand both the technical details and the broader patterns. You’ll work with colleagues who manage everything from Kubernetes clusters to Windows VMs, from Terraform modules to Prometheus monitoring, and you’ll help us find the common threads that allow us to operate more efficiently and reliably.

This is a role with significant room to manoeuvre and influence. You’ll have the opportunity to work with the newest technologies while solving real operational challenges that impact critical systems across multiple domains. Our healthcare solutions, such as Columna, support the continuum of care across hospitals, communities and private homes, so your work contributes directly to patient safety.

Your qualifications

Our ideal candidate is someone who gets excited about patterns, who sees a specific problem and immediately starts thinking “what other problems does this represent?” You’re the engineer who, when asked to automate a deployment, designs a deployment framework. When asked to fix a monitoring gap, you create an observability strategy.

Our ideal candidate would have:

• Experience as a Senior in site reliability engineering, systems engineering, or platform engineering roles with demonstrated impact on infrastructure scalability

• Solid understanding of abstraction and design patterns in infrastructure, with experience creating reusable frameworks, modules, or platforms

• Experience with observability at scale, including metrics, logging, and tracing systems (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar)

• Strong communication skills to articulate architectural decisions, document systems, and mentor others in systems thinking

• Proven ability to architect solutions that solve multiple problems simultaneously, with examples of platforms or systems you’ve built

We value diverse backgrounds and encourage candidates who are passionate about systems thinking, infrastructure architecture, and solving problems at scale to apply, even if they do not meet every requirement perfectly!

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Aarhus

At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

At LEO Pharma, we go beyond the skin to make a lasting difference for people living with skin diseases. Behind that mission is a strong technical foundation, and in this role, you will help ensure that foundation is reliable, compliant and future-ready.

Join LEO Pharma in Ballerup and take on a key technical role at an exciting time of change. As Maintenance Support Professional, you will help keep critical technical installations running, support compliance-based maintenance, and contribute to the proper and structured close-down of the old factory as we prepare for a new innovative production facility to fully take over.

**

Your role**

You will provide technical support for the planning, implementation and development of maintenance across utilities, technical installations, plants and production equipment at Site Ballerup. You will act as a technical problem-solver, resolve technical issues in daily operations while also supporting larger transformation activities related to the factory transition.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Supporting day-to-day operation and availability of both the old and state of the art technical installations and equipment.

• Acting as troubleshooter on ad hoc technical assignments, breakdowns and operational challenges.

• Ensuring maintenance documentation is maintained, optimized and aligned with LEO Pharma policies and GxP requirements.

• Creating, Reviewing and technically approving documents in QMS in close collaboration with stakeholders.

• Supporting the structured close-down of the old factory and contributing to a smooth transition towards the new facility.

You will also be responsible for GxP documentation from the section, including documentation in CMMS and QMS. In addition, you will support timely follow-up on deviations, corrective actions, action items and CAPAs, and act as technical SME in root cause analysis related to deviation handling. You may also participate in relevant CAPEX projects as participant or package owner and lead smaller OPEX projects.

**

Your qualifications**

We imagine that you bring solid technical expertise, good documentation discipline and experience from a regulated environment. You are used to working across functions and can communicate clearly with colleagues and stakeholders at different levels of the organisation.

We are looking for someone with:

• An educational background as an engineer, marine engineer, process technician or equivalent.

• 5+ years’ experience with maintenance of utilities, technical installations, plants or production equipment.

• Hands-on experience with deviation handling, root cause analysis, CAPAs or similar processes.

• Knowledge of GxP, technical documentation and regulated quality processes.

• Experience with CMMS systems such as PEMAC and quality systems such as Veeva Quality is an advantage.

• Experience with RCM (Reliability Centered Maintenance) is an advantage.

As a person, you are proactive, structured and solution-oriented. You enjoy troubleshooting, can manage several tasks at the same time, and are motivated by collaborating across departments to find practical and compliant solutions. You communicate with confidence, build trust with stakeholders and contribute to a positive, LEAN-oriented culture. Working with an optimisation perspective and a focus towards improvements.

**

Your new team**

You will join Maintenance Support at Site Ballerup. We are a team that plays an important role in securing stable technical operations and compliant maintenance. We work closely with Operational Maintenance, Engineering, production areas and laboratories, and we support both daily operations and strategic site changes. Together, we are helping LEO Pharma close one chapter in a responsible way while preparing for the next generation of innovative production.

**

Contact and application**

For additional information, please contact Adam Lundsby Rejkjaer, Senior Team Leader, Maintenance Support at BDYDK@leo-pharma.com

You do not need to upload a cover letter, but feel free to add a few sentences in your resume or CV on why this position has your interest.

Beyond the skin

Join LEO Pharma, a global leader in medical dermatology, as we go beyond the skin to make a lasting impact.  Our innovative approach sets us apart. We are dedicated to leaving a legacy that positively impacts patients, colleagues, and our planet.

At LEO Pharma, we believe in the power of individuals to drive change. Our flat organizational structure empowers you to make a visible impact and offers versatile roles for professional growth. We value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, recognizing that our different perspectives, backgrounds, and attitudes enable us to make the best decisions. Join our passionate team at LEO Pharma and be yourself as we work together to make a difference.

For certain positions, LEO Pharma might complete a background check conducted by a third party.

Join us in this role where you’ll be working as a Senior Operational Technology (OT) Security Officer to strengthen the security, resilience, and compliance of Ørsted Bioenergy. In this role, you will act as a trusted security lead across OT, IT, engineering, and operations, helping protect critical systems while enabling safe, reliable, and efficient operations. Further more we are partnering with operations, engineering, maintenance, IT, and third-party vendors to ensure security controls are practical, risk-based, and compatible with operational safety and availability – and we “translate” technical cyber risk into clear business, safety, and operational impact requirements. We operate in complex, multi-site, international, or safety-critical operational environments.

**Welcome to Bioenergy

**You’ll be part of OT Security where you, together with your colleagues, will be working on Ørsted Danish powerplant. Our task is to protect the powerplants ability to produce electricity and heat against hacker attacks. So you need to understand Danish, when you’re out on the powerplants. We are a small team of 4 persons located in Jutland (Jylland) who works together and strive in helping each other in our daily tasks. As a team, we have an open and direct commutation where we discuss ideas strategy and ideas to develop and mature our solutions, so they are robust and they deal with the reality we face.

You’ll play an important role in:

• leading the development and continuous improvement of OT security governance, policies, standards, and procedures

• assessing, managing, and reducing cyber risk across OT environments, including industrial control systems, SCADA, PLCs, IIoT, and related networks

• defining and supporting secure OT architecture, including network segmentation, secure remote access, asset visibility, access control, logging, monitoring, and vulnerability management

• conducting OT security risk assessments, gap analyses, and maturity reviews aligned with recognised frameworks e.g. Danish legislation “Lov om styrket Beredskab i Energisektoren”, IEC 62443, ISO 27001 and relevant regulatory requirements

• partnering with operations, engineering, maintenance, IT, and third-party vendors to ensure security controls are practical, risk-based, and compatible with operational safety and availability requirements

• driving OT security awareness and training for technical and operational teams.

To succeed in the role, you:

• hold a relevant degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Technology, Automation, or equivalent practical experience

• understand and know how to operate in ICS systems and possess understanding of 24/7 production environment

• are familiar with IT networks like, Purdue model, firewall, data diodes etc.

• hold knowledge about EIC 62433, ISO 27001 and "Lov om styrket Beredskab i Energisektoren" as we operate according to this legislation

• are a good team player and at the same are strong on being responsible of incl. conducting your own tasks – you need to be fluent in both Danish and English language as well due to nature our stake holder landscape

• are flexible - both in terms of taking on tasks outside your comfortzone, being curious in learning new areas and assist your team in whatever tasks are needed.

Some travel within Denmark to the different sites must be expected in the this role.

Working directly with our Senior Trader on the Revenue Desk, you’ll turn fundamental market analysis into strategic recommendations that shape our hedging and proprietary trading positions on the curve up to 5 years out.

**Welcome to Trading & Revenue

We have dedicated model developers, so your focus will be on market research and trading support — not building models from scratch.

We value flexibility, experimentation, and knowledge sharing, working in virtual teams with experienced traders, analysts, meteorologists and other specialists. **You’ll play an important role in:

**

Are you organised, proactive and great at keeping things running smoothly? Do you enjoy coordinating tasks, solving problems and putting your French language skills to use? Then you could be the perfect addition to our customer service team.

About Aduro

At Aduro, we develop, manufacture and market wood-burning stoves, pellet stoves, hybrid stoves and bioethanol fireplaces, all combining innovative technology with modern Danish design. Today, we're proud to be among Europe's five largest wood-burning stove manufacturers, exporting 90% of our production.

Innovation is at the heart of what we do. Several of our products are patented, and we're constantly working to develop new solutions that push the boundaries of our industry.

Sollten wir Ihr neuer Arbeitsplatz sein?

At Aduro, you'll join a growing, dynamic company with a strong entrepreneurial spirit. We believe in sharing ideas, taking responsibility and helping each other succeed. Our working environment is informal and collaborative, with plenty of opportunities to grow both personally and professionally.

We're proud of what we've achieved along the way. We've received the prestigious Gazelle Award seven times, recognising our strong growth. In 2024, we were also finalists for EY's Entrepreneur of the Year award and won the SME Inspiration Award in the Internationalisation category for our international outlook.

At our headquarters, you'll become part of an international team representing seven different nationalities. Different cultures and perspectives come together in an energetic workplace where ambition, teamwork and a good sense of humour go hand in hand. We offer modern facilities, social activities, a company lunch scheme and opportunities to develop your skills and take on new challenges.

**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the teams by creating or helping create great guest experiences, and use every day as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer or staff member; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of people who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You'll learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path—our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**We are looking for an FP&A Specialist to strengthen our Corporate FP&A team and take ownership of cash flow forecasting, balance sheet planning, working capital management, and other key planning activities below Adjusted EBITDA across the Group.

Reporting directly to the Head of FP&A, you will play a key role in advancing our financial planning capabilities and driving transparency across cash flow, liquidity, and balance sheet performance. You will work closely with Accounting, Tax, Controlling, regional Finance teams, and key business stakeholders to ensure robust planning processes and high-quality management reporting.

This is a unique opportunity to:

• Take ownership of the Group's cash flow, balance sheet, and working capital planning agenda, helping to improve cash generation and support management decision-making.

• Shape and develop our Workday Adaptive Planning capabilities, leading key initiatives to establish scalable planning models and reporting structures.

• Work across markets and functions, partnering with regional Finance teams and senior stakeholders to strengthen forecasting, reporting, and business insight throughout the organization.

The successful candidate will help establish best-in-class planning processes that connect P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow forecasting, providing management with greater visibility into liquidity, working capital performance, and long-term value creation. The role is a full-time role and reports to the Head of Group Financial Planning & Analysis.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Own the Group's cash flow planning across forecast, budget, and long-range planning cycles.

• Drive the development of balance sheet forecasting capabilities and ensure alignment between P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow planning.

• Lead the implementation and continuous development of cash flow and balance sheet planning models in Workday Adaptive Planning.

• Define business requirements and partner closely with the BI Team to improve planning processes, reporting capabilities, and system functionality.

• Partner with Accounting, Controlling, Tax, and regional Finance teams to strengthen cash flow and balance sheet reporting, improve forecast accuracy, and establish clear ownership across planning activities.

• Develop and maintain monthly cash flow, balance sheet, and working capital reporting, including variance analysis, key risks and opportunities, and actionable management insights.

• Establish and maintain a clear RACI framework across Finance for balance sheet and cash flow planning, forecasting, and follow-up activities.

• Develop driver-based forecasting methodologies for key working capital metrics, including inventory, receivables, payables, and other material balance sheet accounts.

• Monitor working capital performance and identify opportunities to improve cash conversion and optimize working capital.

• Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Accounting, and Controlling to strengthen understanding of working capital drivers and improve forecast accuracy.

• Support Executive Management and Board reporting by providing insights on cash generation, liquidity, working capital performance, and financial risks and opportunities.

• Drive continuous improvement of forecasting methodologies, planning processes, and financial transparency across the organization.

• Support the ongoing development of FP&A capabilities by integrating balance sheet and cash flow considerations into strategic and long-range planning processes.

**WHO YOU ARE

**You are a curious and analytical finance professional with a passion for turning data into insights and helping the business make better decisions. You enjoy working across functions, building strong stakeholder relationships, and taking ownership of complex planning processes.

You thrive in a dynamic and growing environment and are comfortable navigating between operational details and the bigger picture. You enjoy driving improvements, challenging assumptions, and creating structure where it is needed.

You are comfortable working across Finance functions and partnering with regional Finance teams to improve forecasting, strengthen financial transparency, and drive continuous improvement. Most importantly, you are proactive, structured, and motivated by creating impact through high-quality financial planning and analysis.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• 5+ years of experience within FP&A, Financial Controlling, Corporate Finance, or a similar role.

• Strong understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning.

• Experience working with cash flow forecasting, working capital, balance sheet analysis, or investment planning.

• Solid financial modelling and analytical skills, including advanced Excel capabilities.

• Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning or other EPM/planning tools is an advantage.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• A proactive mindset and a passion for improving processes, systems, and ways of working.

• Experience from retail, hospitality, food & beverage, consumer goods, or other multi-site businesses is considered a plus.

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

**Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

****ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

jobs.occupation: Senior Process Automation Engineer in DCS at Novo Nordisk Engineering
jobs.description:
Senior Process Automation Engineer in DCS, Novo Nordisk Engineering

Do you want to be a part of NNE’s all-time largest Process Automation team? We are looking for colleagues to join our fantastic company, where we have the aspiration of becoming best in class within Automation Solutions for Pharmaceutical Engineering.

Who we are

We are a leading pharma engineering company shaping the future of API pharma engineering globally. Leveraging the expertise of 2,000+ employees across Denmark, India, and the US, we design, build and optimise pharmaceutical manufacturing facilities that are essential to the health and well-being of patients everywhere.

Our success is driven by passion, innovation, and collaboration — with our customers and across our teams and disciplines. If you share our dedication to a noble cause and our passion for API pharma engineering, then NNE is the place for you.

About the role

You will be working in an enthusiastic Process Automation team with more than 80 colleagues in Denmark. Globally, the Process Automation team has more than 200 employees.

The Process Automation team works with consultancy, design & development, implementation and validation of Automation solutions for the Pharma and Biotech industries. Our work is project based, and currently we are looking into an exciting pipeline of large data driven, greenfield plants with modular/scalable designs.

We are skilled in a broad range of process areas within API production e.g. fermentation, recovery and purification, utility, and cleaning systems. And the solutions we provide to our customers are always based on a deep understanding of the customers’ production processes – and if standard components can’t do the job, we develop our own.

How you might spend your days

As a DCS Senior Process Automation Engineer, you’ll be:

• Advising customers on their application process solutions

• Design developing, programming, commissioning, qualifying, FAT, SAT, UAT and Handover of applications for Distributed Control Systems (DCS)

• Interacting with process experts and colleagues with expertise in surrounding systems and equipment like MES, Historian systems, instruments, production equipment etc.

• Developing and optimizing automation methods and strategies to meet our customers’ needs and sharing working knowledge with colleagues and partners

• Forming the basis of automation strategies and architectures to support our sister departments internationally and expand NNE’s Process Automation engagement

Who you are

We care about who you are as a person. In the end, how you work, and your energy is what impacts the results we achieve as a team. As a person, you:

• Understand your colleagues’ individual and cultural difference

• Are aware of your surroundings and able to flag any concerns

• Are agile and able to prioritize urgent tasks

• Are team-oriented and able to collaborate on team projects

• Are reliable, curious and eager to learn

• Are appreciative of feedback, because it contributes to your growth

What you bring to the role

In all positions, there are some things that are preferred, and others, a bonus. If you do not meet all the qualifications listed below, you are welcome to offer alternative experience that you think would be valuable in this role:

• You have 6+ years or more of working experience and hold a degree as an engineer, ideally within electrical, automation, process or marine engineering

• You have 4 years or more of working experience with PCS/DCS Application development (for example ABB 800xA or ABB SattLine), working in GMP/GAMP environment or with execution of Automation projects

• Knowledge of batch production is valued

• You find the complexity of the GMP/GAMP environment exciting

Life at NNE

NNE is short for Novo Nordisk Engineering. And for all of us who work here, NNE means so much more.

At NNE, you become part of a vibrant, project-based environment built on close day-to-day collaboration. The role is therefore primarily on-site, with physical presence at the workplace expected five days a week. Limited flexibility for occasional remote work may be accommodated in line with business needs.

We are, at our core, a people business and, as such, committed to continuously developing our people and the way we work together. We do not expect you to know it all from day one, and we truly believe a great start makes a real difference. We therefore welcome new colleagues with our award-nominated onboarding programme, supported by a range of in-house talent and development initiatives designed to support your long-term growth.

You can read more about the benefits we offer here.

Did we spark your curiosity? If you’re ready to join our passion, let’s hear from you.

Deadline of application is 13th December 2026

Questions before applying? Send us a quick text to arrange a convenient time to chat. Contact Manager Christian Ljørring on +45 30 79 29 08 or Manager Rasmus Sølbeck Hansen +45 31 91 89 30

Please note:

• We only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system

• You do not need to attach a cover letter, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV

• We invite to interviews on a running basis.

Fair hiring:

At NNE, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all job applicants. To maintain fairness, we request that you refrain from including a personal photo in your CV.

FPRT is a Danish-based defense technology company, part of the international Fire Point Group — a fast-growing ecosystem born out of Ukraine’s innovation and resilience. The group was founded by engineers and entrepreneurs who, during the first months of the full-scale war, decided to use their expertise to create advanced defense technologies — including long-range drones and precision systems.

About FPRT

FirePoint Rocket Technology is building a new advanced defence manufacturing facility in Denmark. As we grow towards 300+ employees, we are looking for a hands-on Payroll & HR Operations Specialist to establish reliable people processes and support our transition to a multi-shift production environment.

Reporting to the CHRO, you will work closely with Finance, managers and external payroll and benefits providers. This is an opportunity to shape HR operations from an early stage, not simply maintain existing processes.

What you’ll do

• Coordinate the monthly Danish payroll process, checking salaries, shifts, overtime, allowances and payroll data with our external provider.

• Own accurate time and attendance administration in WorkLinq, working with managers to resolve discrepancies.

• Manage essential HR administration, including contracts, employee changes, pension and benefits coordination, and offboarding.

• Keep employee records and HR systems accurate, organised and compliant with Danish requirements and collective agreements.

• Improve everyday HR processes and reporting as the workforce grows, supporting a potential future transition to in-house payroll.

What we’re looking for

• 3-5+ years of hands-on experience with Danish payroll and HR administration; manufacturing or shift-based experience is an advantage.

• Working knowledge of Danish employment, tax, pension and payroll practices, including collective agreements.

• Confidence using payroll, HR and time-registration systems; experience with WorkLinq or similar tools is welcome.

• Strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy and a practical, service-minded approach.

• Strong language skills in Danish and English, oral and written

Why join FPRT?

• Build scalable payroll and HR operations for a new high-tech manufacturing site.

• Have direct impact on the employee experience and how a growing company operates.

• Work with an international team on a project supporting European security and defence.

• Competitive compensation and a new facility in Vojens.

Interested? We would be pleased to hear from candidates who enjoy combining accurate execution with building better ways of working.

Practical Information

• Full-time position with an immediate start.

• Location: Vojens, Denmark.

• Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible.

• Temp-Team is assisting FPRT with this recruiment so during the initial phases of the recruitment process will be done by Temp-Team and all contact must go via Temp-Team.

Temp-Team

Temp-Team A/S is a national recruitment and staffing agency with eight local departments in Denmark. We have 45 years of experience within staffing and cover a wide range of industries. We focus on delivering high quality and a close personal contact to candidates and clients.

Temp-Team is a part of JuhlerGroup – an international group of recruitment agencies.

The position is based in Roskilde or Warsaw at BEC Financial Technologies' headquarters. The position is organizationally anchored in Service Integration & Security with reference to the Head of Projects & Continuity.

The Service Integration & Security area is responsible for ensuring robust, reliable, and compliant operations across BEC. We work closely with stakeholders across the organization to strengthen operational resilience, including business continuity, IT disaster recovery, crisis management, and risk governance.

As Business Continuity Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring that BEC can continue critical operations during and after disruptive incidents. You will drive the development, implementation, and maintenance of BEC’s continuity framework and collaborate across all domains, programs, and areas.

At BEC, we prefer to collaborate often in the office, while also offering the opportunity to work remotely on average up to 1 day per week.

Primary tasks and responsibilities include:

Continuity & resilience framework:

• Implementing and maintaining BEC’s business continuity management framework

• Maintaining governance for continuity-related processes (Business Continuity, IT Disaster Recovery, Crisis Management, Business Impact Analysis, IT redundancy, Backup & Restore)

• Developing and maintaining Business Continuity Plans (BCPs), Disaster Recovery Plans (DRPs), and Crisis Management Plans

• Defining and maintaining technical requirements for backup and restore processes, including backup scope, retention, encryption, immutability, recovery procedures, and restore validation

Working at

Dalea

A data platform for life science research, where experiments, data and workflows stay structured, traceable and easy to share. Dalea is a data management platform for research in biotech, pharma and academic labs. Scientists keep experiments, structured data, samples and inventory in one place, with full data provenance, in tools that feel familiar to anyone coming from Excel and Word. Today, much of that work is scattered across spreadsheets, personal computers and paper notebooks. Results are hard to find and harder to trust, so teams often re-run experiments rather than track down the ones they’ve already done. In Dalea, everything a lab builds can be packaged and shared: templates, add-ons and whole workflows. Labs can publish, discuss and reuse each other’s work instead of rebuilding it from scratch. Think of it as a GitHub for life science. The same structured, traceable data is what lets AI agents work reliably on real lab data. Dalea is built for regulated research. It has a full audit log, 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11 compliant infrastructure, and full provenance for everything that happens in the platform. It’s hosted in the EU. We’re a small team at BioInnovation Institute in Copenhagen, working with biotech startups, academic labs, pharma R&D teams and CROs.
